meta.name: ai-amazon-vine-program
meta.description: Amazon Vine 决策助手适合运营、产品、销售、software在用户提出“Vine 值得做吗”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成商品/店铺诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议。

copy.tagline: 分析亚马逊Vine计划是否值得参与
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在运营亚马逊店铺，需要判断是否加入Vine计划。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze whether Amazon Vine program is worth joining
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run an Amazon store and need to decide on Vine program participation.

howto.what: 装上后，当你询问“Vine 值得做吗”并提供商品链接、运营目标等材料，Claude 会分析并输出商品/店铺诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议。
howto.when: 当你提出“Vine 值得做吗”这类问题，或需要围绕 Amazon Vine 生成诊断、建议时触发。

say.text: 这个新品适合参加 Vine 吗？
say.note: Claude 会分析商品链接并给出诊断。

say.text: 帮我分析店铺的 Vine 评论风险。
say.note: Claude 会结合店铺链接输出风险提示。

howto.what_en: When you ask 'Is Vine worth it?' and provide product links, goals, etc., Claude analyzes and outputs product/store diagnosis, selling points & risk alerts, and operational action suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask 'Is Vine worth it?' or need diagnosis/suggestions around Amazon Vine.

say_en.text: Is this new product suitable for Vine?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the product link and give a diagnosis.

say_en.text: Analyze the Vine review risks for my store.
say_en.note: Claude will output risk alerts based on the store link.
